_about: Public-domain Sir George Adam Smith (1856-1942, Aberdeen, Old Testament scholar) for the Word Hoard: The Historical Geography of the Holy Land (1895), The Book of Isaiah and The Book of the Twelve Prophets in the Expositor's Bible (2 vols each), The Life of Henry Drummond (1898), Modern Criticism and the Preaching of the Old Testament (1901), Jerusalem (2 vols, 1907-1908), The Early Poetry of Israel (1912), Deuteronomy in the Cambridge Bible (1918) and Jeremiah (1924), from Internet Archive scans and Project Gutenberg. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gasmith-isaiah-2: The Book of Isaiah, vol. II, Expositor's Bible (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MDCCCXC)
gasmith-jeremiah: Jeremiah, the Baird Lecture for 1922 (New York: George H. Doran, 1924)

gasmith-historical-geography: The Historical Geography of the Holy Land (New York: A. C. Armstrong, 1895)
gasmith-isaiah-1: The Book of Isaiah, vol. I, Expositor's Bible (London: Hodder and Stoughton; title page undated)
gasmith-twelve-prophets-1: The Book of the Twelve Prophets, vol. I, Expositor's Bible (New York: A. C. Armstrong, 1896)
gasmith-twelve-prophets-2: The Book of the Twelve Prophets, vol. II, Expositor's Bible (New York: A. C. Armstrong, 1898)
gasmith-henry-drummond: The Life of Henry Drummond (New York: Doubleday & McClure, 1898)
gasmith-modern-criticism: Modern Criticism and the Preaching of the Old Testament (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MCMI)
gasmith-jerusalem-1: Jerusalem: the Topography, Economics and History, vol. I (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MCMVII)
gasmith-jerusalem-2: Jerusalem: the Topography, Economics and History, vol. II (London: Hodder and Stoughton, MCMVIII)
gasmith-early-poetry-israel: The Early Poetry of Israel in its Physical and Social Origins, Schweich Lectures 1910 (London: British Academy, 1912)
gasmith-deuteronomy: The Book of Deuteronomy, Cambridge Bible (Cambridge: University Press, 1918)
